// why: Shared by the three projects. `lib` is ES2022 and `types` is empty on purpose:
a project only sees the globals its runtime really has. The core gets none,
the CLI adds Node's, the mods add herdr-app's (types/gpui-kit.d.ts).
as they are (type stripping): no enums, no parameter properties, `.ts` in imports.
`exactOptionalPropertyTypes`: an optional field takes `undefined` only when its
type says so. herdr's own option types don't, so the hosts spread only set keys.
Declarations are emitted only so `tsc -b` and the editor can treat the three
projects as one solution; they go to node_modules/.cache and nobody reads them.
